summary: Conagra Brands filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.400% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were issued under an existing indenture supplemented by a Fourth Supplemental Indenture, with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. The offering was conducted under Conagra's existing shelf registration statement. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other senior unsecured debt. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation event.
